svg.title: How a Soft Actor-Critic agent learns a position
svg.desc: Six steps in a loop. A market price chart feeds an actor. The actor draws a Gaussian over a raw action, squashes a sample with tanh into a position from short to long, and holds that position through the next price move. The move gives a reward, log growth of equity after costs. The transition goes into a replay buffer, where the same market moment is re-scored with other positions. Two critics predict a spread of returns, and the most optimistic guesses are dropped. Their feedback moves the actor toward valued actions. An entropy thermostat sets how wide the actor's choices stay.
svg.text: How a Soft Actor-Critic agent learns a position
Feedback: move toward valued actions, keep some randomness
Two critics predict a spread of returns
truncated: drop the most optimistic guesses
Illustration: prices are simulated. Real runs add fees, funding and an optional prior (a known premium) to the action.
